children: The funding strengthens Raymond Realty’s asset-light expansion strategy as its MMR portfolio reaches an estimated Rs 52,000 crore GDV

Raymond Realty’s wholly owned subsidiary, Ten X Realty West, has agreed to secure Rs 210 crore from ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund, a Category II alternative investment fund managed by ICICI Prudential AMC. The investment will support the redevelopment of one of the company’s projects in the Mumbai Metropolitan Region.

Raymond Realty and ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund, in its capacity as a financial investor, will jointly invest in Ten X Realty West Limited, according to the company’s regulatory filing on October 26. The subsidiary will undertake the redevelopment project, with the investment structured as part of Raymond Realty’s asset-light expansion strategy.

The capital infusion is aimed at supporting the company’s expansion across premium micro-markets in Mumbai while accelerating the delivery of high-value projects. Raymond Realty said the transaction would help strengthen its asset-light approach as it continues to build its development portfolio across the MMR.

Harmohan Sahni, Managing Director and CEO, Raymond Realty, said the proposed investment marks a defining milestone in the company’s growth trajectory across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. He said the partnership would help the company scale rapidly, improve capital efficiency and accelerate project timelines.

“The proposed financial investment by ICICI Prudential Real Estate Development Fund marks a defining milestone in Raymond Realty’s growth trajectory across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region,” Sahni said. He added that the company would continue focusing on execution and delivering long-term value to stakeholders while expanding through an asset-light strategy.

Raymond Realty’s total portfolio currently has an estimated gross development value of around Rs 52,000 crore, according to the company. The developer said the portfolio reflects a diversified and high-growth asset base across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region, where it has been expanding its residential and commercial development presence.

The company’s asset-light Joint Development Agreement portfolio currently comprises eight projects with a combined revenue potential of around Rs 27,000 crore. The JDA portfolio accounts for approximately 52 per cent of Raymond Realty’s overall GDV, highlighting the increasing role of the model in its development pipeline.

Raymond Realty entered the real estate sector in 2019 and has built a presence across the Mumbai Metropolitan Region. The company currently has around 100 acres of owned land and eight Joint Development Agreements, while its residential portfolio includes TenX, The Address by GS and Invictus by GS.
